author: Diego Sandoval
title: Samad Taylor (oblique strain) placed on 10-day IL
desc: Samad Taylor has been placed on the 10-day injured list with a right oblique strain.
impact: Taylor was originally reported as day-to-day after tweaking his oblique, but he will now hit the injured list. The 27-year-old has been on fire since he was called up on June 3rd, slashing .330/.410/.398 with six stolen bases in 88 at-bats. Luis Rengifo was called up in a corresponding move.

author: Diego Sandoval
title: Luis Rengifo called up to Padres
desc: The San Diego Padres selected the contract of Luis Rengifo on Wednesday.
impact: Rengifo was signed to a minor league contract by the Padres on June 29th, and he will now join the big-league club. The 29-year-old hit .205 with an OPS of .534 in 185 at-bats with the Brewers earlier this season.

author: Diego Sandoval
title: Max Muncy optioned to Triple-A
desc: Max Muncy has been optioned to Triple-A Las Vegas by the Athletics.
impact: Muncy was sent down to the Minor Leagues in a corresponding move with Tyler Soderstrom returning from the IL. Muncy has slashed .227/.303/.396 with five homers and 20 RBI in 154 at-bats at the MLB level this season.

author: Diego Sandoval
title: Austin Warren (right forearm strain) placed on 15-day IL
desc: Austin Warren has been placed on the 15-day injured list with a right forearm strain.
impact: Warren will hit the injured list after allowing five runs on Tuesday without recording an out. He underwent MRIs on Wednesday, but the results are currently unknown. The right-hander has a 4.63 ERA and 37 strikeouts in 35 innings pitched for the Mets this season.

author: Diego Sandoval
title: Matt Seelinger designated for assignment
desc: Matt Seelinger was designated for assignment by the Mets on Wednesday.
impact: Seelinger was called up by the Mets on Tuesday and allowed seven runs in two innings, leading to his DFA on Wednesday. The right-hander will have a chance to find a new home on waivers.

author: Diego Sandoval
title: Tobias Myers recalled from Triple-A
desc: The New York Mets have recalled Tobias Myers to the big-league squad from Triple-A.
impact: Myers has been sent up and down from Triple-A Syracuse multiple times this season, with the latest coming on June 29th. The right-hander has a 6.21 ERA and 32 strikeouts in 42 innings at the MLB level this season.

author: Nate Miller
title: Chadwick Tromp heads to Triple-A
desc: Chadwick Tromp cleared waivers and will head back to Triple-A Norfolk.
impact: Tromp was designated for assignment by the Orioles this past week. The veteran backstop, who has seen time in the bigs with Atlanta and Baltimore this year, will continue to provide organizational depth for the latter.

author: Diego Sandoval
title: Xzavion Curry called up by Mets
desc: The New York Mets selected the contract of Xzavion Curry on Wednesday.
impact: Curry will join the MLB squad for the first time this season after he was signed to a minor-league deal by the Mets in May. The right-hander has a 4.74 ERA and 32 strikeouts in 49 1/3 innings pitched in Triple-A this season.

author: Diego Sandoval
title: Luis Gastelum called up by Cardinals
desc: The St. Louis Cardinals selected the contract of Luis Gastelum from Triple-A Memphis on Wednesday.
impact: Gastelum will join the big-league club for the first time in his career after spending the past three years in the Minor Leagues. The right-handed reliever has a 2.27 ERA, a WHIP of 0.98 and 49 strikeouts in 43 2/3 innings this season at the Triple-A level.

author: Nate Miller
title: Mike Trout (hamstring) officially returning Wednesday
desc: Mike Trout (hamstring) has been activated from the IL ahead of Wednesday's game against the Rangers.
impact: Out since June 17 due to a hamstring injury, Trout will return to the Angels lineup on Wednesday. The future Hall of Famer is only batting .234 this season, but he sports a healthy .866 OPS with 17 homers and seven steals through 74 games. Donovan Walton was designated for assignment in a corresponding move.

author: Diego Sandoval
title: Will Benson clears waivers, assigned to Triple-A Louisville
desc: Will Benson has cleared waivers and was assigned to Triple-A Louisville.
impact: Benson was designated for assignment over the weekend, but will return to the Reds' organization after he was not picked up. The outfielder has struggled this season, hitting just .188 with three homers in 96 at-bats with the MLB club.

author: Nate Miller
title: Donovan Walton designated for assignment
desc: Donovan Walton was designated for assignment on Wednesday.
impact: Walton has played well for the most part over the last several weeks, but he's become the odd man out for the Angels with Mike Trout (hamstring) set to return. Walton has posted a .319/.354/.505 slash line with three homers and eight doubles across 97 plate appearances in the bigs this season. There's a decent likelihood he gets claimed off waivers.

author: Nate Miller
title: Marco Raya (shoulder) lands on IL
desc: Marco Raya (shoulder) was placed on the IL ahead of Wednesday's game against the Guardians.
impact: Raya has pitched fairly well for the Twins since first being called up a couple of weeks ago. The young righty has made three two-inning appearances out of the bullpen, giving up just two runs on five hits and three walks while striking out four. Unfortunately, Raya will now be on the shelf for a bit with a shoulder impingement.

author: Diego Sandoval
title: Rafael Flores recalled by Pirates
desc: The Pittsburgh Pirates have recalled Rafael Flores from Triple-A Indianapolis.
impact: Flores will rejoin the Pirates in a corresponding move to Endy Rodriguez being placed on the injured list. Flores has appeared in two games at the MLB level, belting a homer in one of his three at-bats. In Triple-A this season, Flores has four homers and a .704 OPS in 228 at-bats.

author: Chase Davis
title: Lane Thomas drives in four as Royals outslug Mets 16-12
desc: Lane Thomas went 3-for-4 in Tuesday's win over the Mets with two doubles, one run scored, four RBI, two walks and one strikeout.
impact: Through 77 games, Thomas is batting .232 with six home runs, 29 RBI, 25 runs scored, four stolen bases, a .324 wOBA and a .283 BABIP. He has six RBI during his current five-game hit streak.
